relationships.subject: Medio-dorsal thalamus
relationships.evidence_quote: glutamatergic inputs from the medio-dorsal (MD) thalamus to layer 2/3 pyramidal neurons on the ACC show a significant increase in the fraction of silent synapses

relationships.subject: GluN2B knockdown
relationships.evidence_quote: it not only prevents the generation of these silent synapses following a peripheral neuropathic lesion, but, importantly, it prevents the development of allodynia.

key_findings: Commentary: early neuropathic injury creates transient GluN2B-rich silent synapses from MD thalamus onto ACC L2/3 neurons, needed for allodynia development.
